settings.hero_desc: A detailed miniature of a Single Buoy Mooring (SBM), finished in red and black with piping and fittings, presented in a glass case with a branded plaque. A premium keepsake and gift for offshore, marine and oil & gas firms. Comes with a VIP Gifting box in black velvet.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your unit, colours, plaque text and case
settings.s1_body: A miniature of an offshore asset is a gift people keep on the desk for years. We reproduce your Single Buoy Mooring in detail - the buoy body, manifold, piping and fittings - finished in your colours and presented in a glass case with a branded plaque. Produced in matched batches, it's the ideal premium handout for milestones, handovers and corporate gifting.
settings.case_body: Produced as branded miniatures for MILAHA to give to their government clients, these cased SBM models became a treasured handover gift - displayed on desks long after the milestone, quietly carrying the brand.
settings.case_quote: A superb keepsake of the project. Our client proudly displays it in the office.
settings.prov_p: A flyer is binned; a detailed miniature of your asset is kept. As a branded gift, it carries your name and marks the milestone far longer than any brochure.
